sentences.en: It's hard to say bye to John.
sentences.zh: 跟约翰说再见还真不容易。

sentences.en: I'm trying to make it real and also bye.
sentences.zh: 我正试着表现得真实一点，同时也说声再见。

sentences.en: Give your best crying bye right now.
sentences.zh: 现在来一个你最动情的哭腔再见。

sentences.en: Sean, what's your best cry bye?
sentences.zh: 肖恩，你最拿手的哭腔再见是什么样的？

sentences.en: It had a little bit of vomit in it, too.
sentences.zh: 里面甚至还带了一点呕吐物。

sentences.en: So, uh, I guess they'll let us know.
sentences.zh: 所以，呃，我想他们会通知我们的。

sentences.en: They'll let us know which one they want to go with.
sentences.zh: 他们会告诉我们他们想用哪一个。

sentences.en: Um, my availability is, uh, thank you.

sentences.zh: 你把那个再见给咽下去了。
